calendar: Calendar days including weekends; finish-to-start dependencies with successor starting the next calendar day or later

tasks.name: Initiation and role allocation
tasks.deliverable: Source review, named student and role allocation
tasks.acceptance: Official scope is distinguished from supporting attachments; confirmed roster and open decisions are recorded.

tasks.name: Repository foundation
tasks.deliverable: README, four tracked folders and preserved remote history
tasks.acceptance: Existing repository is cloned and inspected; required directories are tracked; README covers project and actual student.

tasks.name: Project charter and scope
tasks.deliverable: Charter with objectives, boundaries, assumptions and success criteria
tasks.acceptance: All six scenario capabilities are covered; exclusions and policy questions are explicit; full implementation is excluded.

tasks.name: WBS, responsibility and effort
tasks.deliverable: WBS source/export, named RACI and task/person effort totals
tasks.acceptance: All leaf IDs match the schedule; every package has exactly one accountable person; row and column effort sums reconcile.

tasks.name: Schedule and Gantt chart
tasks.deliverable: Editable schedule and dated Gantt with milestones
tasks.acceptance: Dates, durations, dependencies, owners, hours and proposed deadlines are present; dependency and capacity checks pass.

tasks.name: Risk assessment and responses
tasks.deliverable: Scored risk register with triggers, mitigations and contingencies
tasks.acceptance: At least eight relevant risks have likelihood, impact, calculated score, owner and distinct mitigation/contingency actions.

tasks.name: Issues, commits and A1 evidence review
tasks.deliverable: Assigned Issues, genuine remote commits, screenshots and A1 audit
tasks.acceptance: Each major task has a real assigned Issue; at least three meaningful new commits are remote; evidence index and compliance audit identify all remaining actions.

tasks.name: Stakeholder analysis
tasks.acceptance: At least librarian, student, faculty and administrator needs are recorded; any consultations use genuine evidence.

tasks.name: Requirements, stories and criteria
tasks.deliverable: Requirements list, user stories and measurable acceptance criteria
tasks.acceptance: At least 10 FR, four NFR, five assumptions/constraints and eight user stories with measurable acceptance criteria are reviewed.

tasks.name: SRS, AI review and traceability
tasks.deliverable: Structured SRS, AI-review decisions and traceability matrix
tasks.acceptance: SRS contains all specified sections, contents and revision history; at least five AI suggestions have justified decisions; trace links are verified.

tasks.name: Use-case and class diagrams
tasks.deliverable: Editable use-case/class diagrams, exports and explanations
tasks.acceptance: Correct UML notation and multiplicities; required domain classes; consistency with the approved SRS.

tasks.name: Borrowing and return UML
tasks.deliverable: Borrowing sequence and return/overdue activity diagrams
tasks.acceptance: Borrowing validation and loan creation are modeled; return includes overdue handling; editable files and exports match the SRS.

tasks.name: Five-screen UI design
tasks.deliverable: Login, student dashboard, search, details and librarian screens
tasks.acceptance: Five coherent accessible screen designs cover the specified functions; design files are editable.

tasks.name: Clickable prototype and workflows
tasks.deliverable: Figma prototype with reservation and issue/return workflows
tasks.acceptance: A real share link and clickable interactions demonstrate both workflows; screenshots represent the actual file.

tasks.name: Usability testing and improvements
tasks.deliverable: Two real classmates' feedback and two evidenced improvements
tasks.acceptance: Actual participants test both workflows; observations are recorded; at least two changes trace to genuine feedback.

tasks.name: Final QA and submission handover
tasks.deliverable: Cross-artifact QA, evidence index and final submission package
tasks.acceptance: SRS, UML and UI are consistent; all links/exports open; submission checklist is complete; real human evidence is distinguished from templates.

risks.trigger: Conflicting or unanswered policy questions at SRS review
risks.mitigation: Maintain a policy-question log; prioritize librarian confirmation before baselining.
risks.contingency: Record explicitly proposed rules, isolate affected requirements and re-review after clarification.

risks.risk: Effort estimates exceed one student's availability
risks.trigger: Actual hours exceed estimate by 20% or a planned day exceeds six hours
risks.mitigation: Allocate all role hours to Talal; check aggregate daily demand; review estimates at each gate.
risks.contingency: Use the 15% effort reserve, re-sequence discretionary polish and propose revised dates to the instructor.

risks.risk: Repository URL or effective write access fails
risks.trigger: A future push or Issue operation returns an access error; initial HTTP 403 issue is resolved
risks.mitigation: Use the verified trailing-dot URL; owner connector installation and successful Git push/Issue creation now verify effective access; check again at each gate.
risks.contingency: Owner restores app access or publishes from an authorized CLI account; retain local commits and package without creating a replacement remote.

risks.risk: Student unavailable during a critical work package
risks.trigger: Two planned work sessions missed or a milestone is forecast late
risks.mitigation: Keep tasks small and editable; confirm calendar availability; preserve handover notes.
risks.contingency: Replan around remaining capacity; request a deadline adjustment if needed; do not invent another contributor.

risks.risk: Official deadlines differ from proposed dates
risks.trigger: Instructor supplies dates earlier than current proposed gates
risks.mitigation: Keep every proposed date labeled; request actual submission dates before baselining.
risks.contingency: Recalculate the dependency network and effort/capacity; obtain revised scope or timing agreement.

risks.trigger: No consultation or testing slot confirmed before the relevant phase
risks.mitigation: Request availability early and prepare focused questions and a short test script in the appropriate phase.
risks.contingency: Reschedule with actual eligible participants; disclose missing evidence and seek instructor guidance.

risks.risk: Git conflicts or accidental loss of existing work
risks.trigger: Remote head changes, conflict appears, or an export is overwritten
risks.mitigation: Inspect before editing; fetch before pushing; keep editable sources; use normal pushes and reviews.
risks.contingency: Resolve on a branch, recover from Git and verify against the last reviewed baseline; never force-push.

risks.risk: Figma access or prototype interactions delayed
risks.trigger: Figma creation, sharing or interaction checks fail at UI kickoff
risks.mitigation: Confirm account/tool access before design; retain source assets and a workflow checklist.
risks.contingency: Prepare a local aid and precise Figma completion steps; mark the Figma requirement incomplete until the actual file works.

risks.risk: SRS, UML and UI use inconsistent rules or terms
risks.trigger: Review finds a workflow or term that cannot be traced to the baseline
risks.mitigation: Use a glossary, requirement IDs and cross-artifact review at M2–M4.
risks.contingency: Pause dependent approvals, fix the source requirement and update all impacted diagrams/screens.

risks.risk: Testing or screenshots are missing or unreadable
risks.trigger: Evidence index contains a missing file, illegible image or unsupported claim
risks.mitigation: Capture real pages/artifacts, record URLs/times, open exports and audit every evidence link.
risks.contingency: Recapture actual state; mark unavailable evidence Pending or Blocked rather than recreating it.

risks.trigger: Tasks add backend, deployment, real data migration or live notifications
risks.mitigation: Keep the PDF's analysis/design boundary in the charter and review every scope change.
risks.contingency: Defer implementation requests and restore effort to mandatory assessment artifacts.

risks.risk: Repository trailing period conflicts with required literal name
risks.trigger: Instructor requires the exact repository spelling from the PDF
risks.mitigation: Disclose the name difference and ask the owner/instructor to confirm acceptability.
risks.contingency: Owner renames the existing repository; update origin, document links, Issue map and screenshots; preserve history.
